balances.freebet_balance: Stored in wallets.freebet_balance; usable for bet placement (fund_source: FREEBET); returns only net profits (stake not returned); non-withdrawable
balances.bonus_balance: Stored in wallets.bonus_balance; subject to wagering requirements in user_bonuses; forfeited upon initiating a cash withdrawal to prevent bonus abuse
balances.locked_deposit_balance: Stored in wallets.locked_deposit_balance; enforces 1x turnover before withdrawal

safeguards: Free bets cannot be directly withdrawn (excluded from availableBalance calculation)
Bonus forfeiture on withdrawal prevents cashing out unearned promotional funds
Daily spin grants enforced by unique daily_spins (user_id, spin_date) constraint
